description: This file defines the ApiClient class which provides a singleton instance for accessing a REST API via Retrofit. It initializes the Retrofit client with logging, base URL, and JSON converter, and exposes an EventsService interface for API calls.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to the EventsService API interface, responsible for configuring Retrofit with logging and JSON conversion.

methods.name: ApiClient constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ApiClient instance, sets up Retrofit and the EventsService interface.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton ApiClient instance if not already initialized, requiring a Context.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton ApiClient instance if initialized, otherwise throws an exception.
